usedFor: LiveChat holds your website conversations, and HubSpot turns the people in them into contacts once a chat ends.

bestTemplate.name: “Finished Chat” in LiveChat, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It matches on email, creating the contact or updating the existing one, so a returning visitor is not added twice.

watchOut: “Create Contact” in HubSpot requires an email, so a chat that never captured one cannot make a record.
